  ];
  var TOPICS=['SEO & Search','AI & Automation','Healthcare Marketing','Google Ads','Content Marketing','E-E-A-T','Landing Page Optimisation','Social Media','Brand Authority','Local SEO','LLM & AI Search','Digital Strategy'];

  var state={cat:'all',tag:null,au:null,q:''};
  var grid=document.getElementById('blGrid');
  var active=document.getElementById('blActive');

  function esc(s){return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;');}
  function cardHTML(a,i,feat){
    var slug='bl-thumb-'+a.t.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').slice(0,40);
    return '<article class="bl-card'+(feat?' feat':'')+'">'+
      '<a class="cardlink" href="#" aria-label="Read: '+esc(a.t)+'"></a>'+
      '<div class="bl-thumb"><image-slot id="'+slug+'" shape="rect" placeholder="'+CATLBL[a.cat]+' image"></image-slot></div>'+
      '<div class="body">'+
        '<span class="bl-tag" data-cat="'+a.cat+'">'+CATLBL[a.cat]+'</span>'+
        '<h3>'+esc(a.t)+'</h3>'+
        (feat&&a.ex?'<p class="excerpt">'+esc(a.ex)+'</p>':'')+
        '<div class="bl-meta"><span class="av">'+a.ai+'</span><span class="nm">'+a.au+'</span><span class="sepdot"></span><span>'+a.date+'</span><span class="rt">'+a.rt+' read</span></div>'+
      '</div></article>';
  }
  function applyFilter(){
    var q=state.q.trim().toLowerCase();
    var list=ARTICLES.filter(function(a){
      if(state.cat!=='all'&&a.cat!==state.cat)return false;
      if(state.tag&&a.tags.indexOf(state.tag)<0)return false;
      if(state.au&&a.au!==state.au)return false;
      if(q){ var hay=(a.t+' '+a.tags.join(' ')+' '+a.au).toLowerCase(); if(hay.indexOf(q)<0)return false; }
      return true;
    });
    if(!list.length){
      grid.innerHTML='<div class="bl-empty"><div class="ico"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg></div>No articles here yet &mdash; try another category or topic.</div>';
    } else {
      grid.innerHTML=list.map(function(a,i){return cardHTML(a,i,(i+1)%6===0);}).join('');
    }
    // active filter banner
    var lbl=null;
    if(state.tag)lbl='Topic: '+state.tag;
    else if(state.au)lbl='Author: '+state.au;
    if(lbl){
      active.style.display='block';
      active.innerHTML='<button type="button" id="blClear" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);background:rgba(54, 192, 237,.08);border:1px solid rgba(54, 192, 237,.2);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer">'+esc(lbl)+' <span style="font-size:14px;line-height:1">&times;</span></button>';
      document.getElementById('blClear').onclick=function(){state.tag=null;state.au=null;applyFilter();};
    } else { active.style.display='none'; active.innerHTML=''; }
  }

  // Tabs
  document.getElementById('blTabs').addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest('.bl-tab'); if(!b)return;
    this.querySelectorAll('.bl-tab').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected','false');});
    b.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
    state.cat=b.dataset.cat; state.tag=null; state.au=null; applyFilter();
  });
  // Search
  var sw=document.getElementById('blSearch');
  sw.querySelector('.tog').addEventListener('click',function(){
    sw.classList.toggle('open');
    if(sw.classList.contains('open'))document.getElementById('blQ').focus();
  });
  document.getElementById('blQ').addEventListener('input',function(){state.q=this.value;applyFilter();});

  // Topics
  var tc=document.getElementById('blTopics');
  tc.innerHTML=TOPICS.map(function(t){
    var n=ARTICLES.filter(function(a){return a.tags.indexOf(t)>=0;}).length;
    var fs=(14+Math.min(n,4)*1.6).toFixed(1);
    return '<button type="button" class="bl-topic" data-tag="'+t.replace(/"/g,'')+'" style="font-size:'+fs+'px">'+t+(n?'<span class="ct">'+n+'</span>':'')+'</button>';
  }).join('');
  tc.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest('.bl-topic'); if(!b)return;
    state.tag=b.dataset.tag; state.au=null; state.cat='all';
    document.querySelectorAll('.bl-tab').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected',x.dataset.cat==='all'?'true':'false');});
    applyFilter();
    window.scrollTo({top:document.querySelector('.bl-grid-sec').offsetTop-120,behavior:'smooth'});
  });

  // Authors
  var ag=document.getElementById('blAuthors');
  ag.innerHTML=AUTHORS.map(function(a,i){

  }).join('');
  ag.addEventListener('click',function(e){

    state.au=b.dataset.au; state.tag=null; state.cat='all';
    document.querySelectorAll('.bl-tab').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected',x.dataset.cat==='all'?'true':'false');});
    applyFilter();
    window.scrollTo({top:document.querySelector('.bl-grid-sec').offsetTop-120,behavior:'smooth'});
  });

  // Pagination (visual)
  document.getElementById('blPage').addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest('button'); if(!b||b.disabled||!b.textContent.trim())return;
    if(!/^[0-9]+$/.test(b.textContent.trim()))return;
    this.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){x.removeAttribute('aria-current');});
    b.setAttribute('aria-current','true');
  });

  applyFilter();
})();
